record.question: Answer any 5 (five) of the following: (a) What is an approximate proportion of cement, Sand & concrete for M20 nominal mix cement concrete? (b) What is the characteristic strength of M25 concrete? (c) Why the Strength of cement decrease if the water is added less than or more than the optimum water cement ration in the concrete mix with all other conditions remains the same? (d) Where the bending moment of cantilever beam is maximum? (e) Write a note on curing of concrete (f) Write a note on importance of maintaining clear cover for RCC work and minimum clear cover for slab, beam columns and water retaining structure? (g) What is the function of stirrups on a beam?

paper.title: DEPARTMENTAL EXAMINATIONS FOR JUNIOR GRADE OF M.E.S. (AE/SDO) UNDER PUBLIC HEALTH ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT - CIVIL ENGINEERING PAPER II
